name: fishing-accident-prepare-2-paid-ally-to-bottom-of-deck
notes: Fishing Accident (RRx0KK6g6D, WATER ASSASSIN ACTION, Fast, reserve 1): "Prepare 2. Rest target ally. If Fishing Accident was prepared, put that ally on the bottom of its owner's deck instead." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with the lineage cards needed for the card's element. Player 1 ends turn 1; player 2 activates the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, a 'Take a fast action?' confirmation because the card is Fast, 100 reserve payments, player 1's PASS in the opportunity window, then the YES/NO answer and target choice). Player 1 controls a Dungeon Guide (p1Field-1) as the target; the champion holds 2 preparation counters. Player 2 pays Prepare 2 and targets the Dungeon Guide: it leaves player 1's field and goes to the bottom of player 1's deck (deck 11 -> 12, last card) instead of being rested.

rulesClauses: Rest target ally. If Fishing Accident was prepared, put that ally on the bottom of its owner's deck instead.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The CardEditor ability row for this card never queued the fixed Prepare cost: no $cardActivatedAbilities['RRx0KK6g6D:0'] entry existed (or, for the Strike from the Mist stub, it was an empty '(engine)' body), so OnCardActivated() queued no 'Pay Prepare N?' decision and wasPrepared was never YES. Live state dump on HEAD 47028d36 before the fix: after the last reserve payment the decision queue went straight to the attack-target / ally-target choice (no YESNO), preparation counters stayed untouched, and answering YES was rejected as 'Invalid selection' (or silently ignored) -- so the card's 'if prepared' rider was unreachable. Fix: hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['RRx0KK6g6D:0'] queues the Prepare 2 YES/NO first, then the ally MZCHOOSE and customDQHandlers['GAFishingAccidentResolve'] (bottom of owner's deck when prepared, else rest).
